summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market ordinary share repurchase on 26 May 2026. The company bought 4,000,000 shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 101.4687 pence per share, with a highest price of 101.80p and lowest of 101.00p. The purchase is part of an existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled, reducing the share count. This is an ongoing capital return program with no stated expiration. Watch for continued execution pace and potential impact on EPS.
